summary: Audited all 3000 MCQs in waves 1-6 (Units 1-3) against four logic gates. Arithmetic verified by recalculation of every numeric item (market share, added value, cost-plus mark-up, pay/commission, labour turnover, PED, percentages/quotas, tariff break-even and revenue) plus a manual sample; all stated answers and worked reasons were mathematically correct. Key gate clean (valid correctOption, options[correctOption]==correctAnswer, four distinct options, no ambiguous keys). No boilerplate found. Gate 3 fails: 27 items use generic filler ('Incorrect calculation.'/'Incorrect arithmetic.'/'Incorrect mathematical calculation.') as a wrong-option reason instead of a specific explanation of why that option is wrong.
